method: paired McNemar (errors only) + paired bootstrap 95% CIs (n_resamples=1000, seed=42) for precision/recall/F1 and ROC-AUC/PR-AUC differences, on identical examples aligned on email_id
correction: Holm-Bonferroni across the McNemar family WITHIN each set (primary); global Holm across all pairs x sets reported as a sensitivity check; Bonferroni-adjusted p for reference. Significant = Holm-adjusted p < 0.05.
multi_seed_note: Checkpoints are single (one RoBERTa checkpoint, one BiLSTM artefact, one TF-IDF refit per model); no multi-seed variability is claimed.

mcnemar.note: McNemar compares overall errors only; it is NOT a precision test and says nothing about which model has higher precision or recall.

H1b_operational.note: Deployment criteria are recall floor 0.85 (predefined) plus the operational metrics in the Final Decision (precision, FPR, latency). H1b is judged on those, never on ROC-AUC/PR-AUC.
